macro_context.market_sentiment: Broadly risk-on with cautious optimism: S&P 500 hit a new all-time high of 7,259 on May 5 and Nasdaq closed at 25,326; today (May 6) markets are edging higher (S&P +0.72%, Nasdaq +0.73%) on reports of a potential U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal, though oil at ~$110/bbl remains an overhang.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates steady at 3.50-3.75% on April 29 (Powell's final meeting as chair) with a historic four dissents; SEP projects one rate cut in 2026 and revised GDP growth down to 0.9% for the year, citing Middle East energy uncertainty and elevated inflation.
macro_context.geopolitical: U.S.-Iran conflict over the Strait of Hormuz is the dominant risk — now in its third month and effectively halting tanker traffic; oil spiked above $100/bbl in March and has crept back toward $110. A U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding is reportedly 48 hours away, which could ease energy prices. Tariff uncertainty and midterm elections add background noise.
key_events: Potential U.S.-Iran ceasefire MOU announcement within 48 hours (could sharply reduce oil prices and boost equities)
Next FOMC meeting (no May meeting scheduled; next decision likely June 2026)
U.S. midterm elections in November 2026 creating policy uncertainty
Ongoing Strait of Hormuz disruption risk to energy and consumer spending

ticker_news.headline: Meta Q1 2026 beats estimates: revenue $56.31B (+33% YoY), adj. EPS $10.44 vs $8.15 est; stock fell 6%+ after-hours on raised capex guidance of $125-145B
Meta announces layoffs of ~8,000 employees (10% of workforce) starting May 20, cancelling 6,000 open roles as $135B AI spending reshapes the company
Meta raises 2026 capex forecast to $125-145B (up from $115-135B) to fund AI infrastructure, alarming investors about ROI timeline
Meta secures ~$13B financing from Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan for 1-gigawatt El Paso AI data centre (target opening 2028)
Reuters wins Pulitzer Prize for beat reporting on Meta knowingly exposing users (including children) to harmful AI chatbots and profiting from fraudulent ads

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Strong Buy consensus from 61 of 78 Wall Street analysts (0 Sells); median price target $856 (range $676-$1,144). Rothschild & Co upgraded from Neutral to Buy in January 2026. Post-earnings reaction led to a Hold call from at least one analyst in the low-to-mid $700s range, citing near-term capex overhang. Overall bullish consensus intact. (Sources: MarketBeat, Chartmill, StockAnalysis)

competitor_activity: Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft are collectively spending $630B+ on AI infrastructure in 2026 alongside Meta, intensifying the compute arms race. TikTok (ByteDance) remains the primary social attention threat, particularly among younger demographics. Snap and Pinterest are marginal competitors. No major competitor product launches this week, but AMD's strong Q1 earnings (beat on May 5) signal healthy AI chip demand across the hyperscaler ecosystem.
earnings_info: Q1 2026 reported April 29: EPS $7.31 (beat $6.67 est), revenue $56.31B (beat ~$55.5B est). Next earnings (Q2 2026) expected approximately July 29, 2026 (after market close, unconfirmed). No official EPS/revenue estimate yet for Q2 widely reported.
